title: Count Total Set Bits to N
description: Given a non-negative 64-bit integer `n`, return the total number of set bits (`1`s) across the binary representations of all integers from `0` to `n` inclusive.
hints: In the sequence `0, 1, 2, ..., n`, bit position `b` repeats a periodic pattern of `2^b` zeros followed by `2^b` ones (period `2^(b + 1)`).
For each bit `b` with `2^b <= n`, count full cycles in `m = n + 1` plus the partial remainder `max(0, (m % 2^(b + 1)) - 2^b)`.

examples.explanation: Binary forms for 0..3 are 0, 1, 10, 11 -> 0 + 1 + 1 + 2 = 4 set bits.
Binary forms for 0..5 add 100 (1) and 101 (2) to 4, totaling 7 set bits.
